title: Responsiveness & interactive-state QC for tokens, buttons, tables, charts across Safari/Firefox/mobile
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Validate responsive behavior and interactive states (hover, focus, active, disabled) for core UI kit primitives and composed components across Safari (macOS & iOS), Firefox (desktop & Android), and common mobile viewports. Focus areas: design tokens (spacing, type, color/contrast), primary/secondary button variants, data table row expansion and sticky headers, and chart redraw/resizing behaviors. Deliverables: triage list with severity/prio, reproduction steps + screenshot/video evidence, targeted fixes in component library, and updated QA matrix + automated visual test snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: All failing visual/interaction issues for tokens/buttons/tables/charts documented with steps to reproduce and a minimum reproduction sandbox
Priority P0/P1 bugs have tickets assigned to engineering or design for fixes
Updated cross-browser QA matrix and device list committed to the design repo
Automated Percy/Chromatic snapshots added for the regression cases identified
Figma tokens and the runtime token mapping doc reconciled for color/spacing mismatches
steps_to_reproduce: Open the UI kit playground in Safari (macOS Ventura) at desktop widths 1280px and 1440px
Verify primary and ghost button focus ring and outline behavior when tabbing and when clicked quickly in succession
Reduce viewport to common mobile widths (375px, 428px) and check table overflow behavior, row truncation, and horizontal scrolling affordances
Load the sample chart component and toggle dataset sizes to trigger redraws; observe label clipping and axis recompute timing in Firefox desktop
Switch system font-size / zoom levels to emulate accessibility settings and confirm token-driven spacing scales correctly
observations_and_findings: Safari macOS: focus ring for ghost button inconsistently appears after rapid clicks (possible repaint/outline suppression)
Firefox desktop: table sticky header sometimes detaches when virtualized rows are toggled; appears related to transform: translateZ usage
iOS Safari: chart SVG tooltip tap targets are smaller than touch guidelines when device pixel ratio > 2
Android Firefox: CSS gap in responsive grid collapses at certain breakpoints due to older layout engine rounding
Design tokens: 1px borders token resolves differently in high-DPI contexts leading to perceived thickness differences
temporary_workarounds_suggested: Add explicit -webkit-focus-ring-color fallback for ghost button focus styles to avoid disappearance in Safari
Avoid transform-based positioning for sticky table headers; use top + position: sticky where possible
Increase chart SVG tooltip hit area with invisible padding rects for touch devices
Normalize 1px border rendering by using hairline utilities and media-query-based border-width adjustments for DPR
next_steps: Assign ENG owners for ENG-2291 and ENG-2330 to implement fixes and link PRs back here
Create chore to update token mapping doc and add small token audit (DES-12754)
Add failing cases to storybook and gate with visual snapshots in CI
Schedule a short sync with frontend infra to review sticky header transform implications (link meeting notes)
